title: User interfaces for volumetric displays
abstract: Volumetric displays, which enable true 3D image visualization, hold the promise of enhancing rendered 3D graphics' sense of realism by providing all the depth cues humans require. Although still in the prototype stage, 3D volumetric displays present unique user interface challenges. The authors use physical mock-ups to explore solutions to interaction styles for 3D volumetric displays.
